# MeritPrep 2.0 mandatory instructions

Before every task, read `/AGENTS.md`, `/docs/ACADEMIC_LESSON_MASTERY_STANDARD.md` and `/docs/LESSON_RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md`. Complete the applicable checklist with evidence.

Work only in this repository. Preserve the existing Kotlin/Jetpack Compose app and its working features. Map lessons to current official JAMB and WAEC syllabus statements. Teach from zero assumed knowledge to independent examination competence. Integrate appropriate original visuals, animations, simulations and complete virtual practicals inside lessons. Label simulated data, document assumptions and limitations, and respect third-party licences. Add tests, run the Android build and verify CI for the exact commit. Report unresolved gaps honestly; never claim complete syllabus coverage without statement-level evidence.

A request to Continue means continue hands-on implementation, not return only a plan.


## Merit reference repository rule

Use `kayceenet/Merit` only to study UI structure and interaction patterns. Do not copy or paraphrase any of its lesson prose, course explanations, worked examples, questions, answers, scenarios, practical instructions or marking points. MeritPrep 2.0 content must be original and independently aligned to its own syllabus evidence. Never modify the reference repository.
